allow: Merging a pull request into `main` with `gh pr merge` is allowed without a separate human reviewer. This project is solo-owned: the owner is the only reviewer and has delegated merges to Claude. The project's own rule still applies (CLAUDE.md, CONTRIBUTING.md): every change reaches `main` through a PR whose CI is green, never a direct push. Check `gh pr checks` first and never merge on red.
Reading pull request state (`gh pr view`, `gh pr checks`, `gh pr list`) is always allowed — it changes nothing.

Configuring GitHub branch protection on this repository with `gh api ... /branches/*/protection` is allowed. It is how CLAUDE.md constitutional rule 1 is enforced, and it restricts what can be done to the repo rather than widening it.
